summary_en: Godo Kaisha Kodo, a special purpose company established by Daikokuya Holdings' representative director Shoji Shimano, is launching a tender offer to acquire all shares of Daikokuya Holdings Co., Ltd. (Code: 6993) listed on TSE Standard Market. The offeror has entered into an agreement to acquire 485,055,672 shares (64.38% of outstanding shares) held by S Bank, a fund managed by Keystone Partners. Shimano is expected to continue as representative director post-completion.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of Daikokuya Holdings Co., Ltd. (Security Code: 6993) by Godo Kaisha Kodo
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, Godo Kaisha Kodo (the offeror) announced the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of Daikokuya Holdings Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, Code 6993). The offeror is a special purpose company established on August 27, 2026, by Shoji Shimano, who serves as Daikokuya's representative director. Keystone Partners' managed fund holds 99% of the offeror through S Bank, with Shimano holding 1%.

Under a tender offer agreement executed on November 9, 2026, the offeror has committed to acquire 485,055,672 shares held by S Bank, representing 64.38% of outstanding shares (calculated as 485,055,672 divided by 753,430,833, which includes 741,930,833 ordinary shares net of treasury stock plus 11,500,000 shares underlying warrant issuances). The tender offer constitutes a management buyout (MBO), with Shimano expected to remain as the company's representative director and continue managing operations following completion of the transaction.

The offeror, Keystone Partners, Tokyo Wells, and Shimano currently hold no shares in Daikokuya Holdings. Tokyo Wells and Daikokuya have no capital, personnel, or transaction relationships. The announcement was made in accordance with Financial Instruments and Exchange Act enforcement ordinance Article 30(1)(4) on the basis of a request from the offeror to Daikokuya Holdings.
